messages.content: You are an expert evaluator of AI assistant answers.

You are an expert judge evaluating the quality of two AI assistants' answers to the same user question. Compare them on helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, and completeness. One answer was produced first in the conversation (position 1), the other later (position 2). Do not favour either position: if an answer is longer, credit it only if the extra text is actually useful.

--- QUESTION (USER) ---
Imagine you are writing a blog post comparing two popular smartphone models. Develop an outline for the blog post, including key points and subheadings to effectively compare and contrast the features, performance, and user experience of the two models. Please answer in fewer than 200 words.

--- ANSWER 1 (from AI Assistant A) ---
I. Introduction
A. Explanation of the purpose of the blog post
B. Brief overview of the two smartphone models being compared

II. Design and Build
A. Physical appearance and dimensions
B. Materials used and durability
C. Display and camera quality
D. Ergonomics and comfort

III. Performance
A. Processor and memory
B. Battery life and charging
C. Operating system and user interface
D. Gaming and multitasking capabilities

IV. User Experience
A. Interface and customization options
B. Software features and apps
C. Connectivity and networking
D. Accessibility and inclusivity

V. Price and Value
A. Cost of the devices
B. Extra features and accessories
C. Warranty and customer service
D. Resale value and market demand

VI. Conclusion
A. Recap of the key points
B. Final thoughts and recommendations
C. Suggestions for further research or comparison.

--- ANSWER 2 (from AI Assistant B) ---
I. Introduction
    A. Brief overview of the two popular smartphone models
    B. Purpose of the comparison

II. Design and Build
    A. Materials and durability
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    B. Size and weight
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    C. Color options
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2

III. Display
    A. Screen size and resolution
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    B. Display technology
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2

IV. Performance
    A. Processor and RAM
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    B. Battery life
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    C. Operating system and updates
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2

V. Camera
    A. Rear and front camera specifications
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    B. Camera features and software
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2

VI. Additional Features
    A. Unique features of Model 1
    B. Unique features of Model 2

VII. User Experience
    A. Ease of use and interface
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    B. Customization options
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    C. User reviews and ratings
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2

VIII. Price and Availability
    A. Pricing for different storage options
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2
    B. Carrier availability and deals
        1. Model 1
        2. Model 2

IX. Conclusion
    A. Summary of key differences
    B. Recommendations for different user preferences

First write a short explanation (2-4 sentences) comparing the two answers and what you found decisive. Then, on a final line by itself, give your verdict using exactly one of these labels:

Judge: A

Judge: B

Judge: tie

response:
Both assistants provide structured outlines that meet the core requirements of the prompt. However, Answer 1 is superior because it adheres to the strict word count constraint (fewer than 200 words), whereas Answer 2 significantly exceeds it (approx. 350+ words). Additionally, Answer 1 offers a more logical flow by grouping related features (like display and camera under Design/Build or Performance) rather than creating excessive sub-sections for each model, which makes the outline more practical for a blog post format.

Judge: A
